problem: Deliver a multi-tenant, multi-region API service that exposes Ethereum mainnet, Sepolia testnet, Bitcoin, and Cardano on-chain data (current and historical/archive) to authenticated developers via each chain's native JSON-RPC and WebSocket subscription surface, with reorg-safe semantics (rollback notifications + finality tags), per-API-key rate limits and quotas, residency-pinned tenant data, hash-chained compliance audit, lease-token-fenced single-writer-per-tenant writes, M-of-N operator-credential governance, and emergency cert-bootstrap rooted in an OOB hardware anchor.
